name: annual_mean_and_coverage
error: PartitionKeyError("PartitionKeyError: The partition_by bucket 'year(period_start)' is not one of the query's time dimensions.\n  at aggregation 'sum'\n  suggestion: Add it to time_dimensions, or choose one of: municipality.")

name: shared_root_period_compare

measures.name: change
measures.formula: (1000 * sum(vehicles.n) / nullif(sum(population.n, partition_by=[municipality, year(period_start)]), 0)) - time_shift(1000 * sum(vehicles.n) / nullif(sum(population.n, partition_by=[municipality, year(period_start)]), 0), -1, 'year')

sql:
WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    cells.municipality AS "cells.municipality",
    vehicles.kind AS "cells.vehicles.kind",
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', cells.period_start) AS "cells.period_start"
  FROM cells AS cells
  LEFT JOIN vehicles AS vehicles
    ON cells.id = vehicles.cell_id
  WHERE
    (
      cells.period_start >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
      AND cells.period_start < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
    )
  GROUP BY
    cells.municipality,
    vehicles.kind,
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', cells.period_start)
), _cm_cells__population__n_sum_partition_by_municipality_period_start AS (
  SELECT
    cells.municipality AS "population.cells.municipality",
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', cells.period_start) AS "population.cells.period_start",
    CAST(SUM(population.n) AS DOUBLE) AS "population.n_sum_partition_by_cells_municipality_cells_period_start"
  FROM population AS population
  LEFT JOIN cells AS cells
    ON population.cell_id = cells.id
  WHERE
    cells.period_start >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND cells.period_start < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
  GROUP BY
    cells.municipality,
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', cells.period_start)
), _cm_cells__vehicles__n_sum AS (
  SELECT
    cells.municipality AS "vehicles.cells.municipality",
    vehicles.kind AS "vehicles.kind",
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', cells.period_start) AS "vehicles.cells.period_start",
    CAST(SUM(vehicles.n) AS DOUBLE) AS "vehicles.n_sum"
  FROM vehicles AS vehicles
  LEFT JOIN cells AS cells
    ON vehicles.cell_id = cells.id
  WHERE
    cells.period_start >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND cells.period_start < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
  GROUP BY
    cells.municipality,
    vehicles.kind,
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', cells.period_start)
), base AS (
  SELECT
    _base."cells.municipality",
    _base."cells.vehicles.kind",
    _base."cells.period_start",
    1000 * _cm_cells__vehicles__n_sum."vehicles.n_sum" / NULLIF(
      NULLIF(
        _cm_cells__population__n_sum_partition_by_municipality_period_start."population.n_sum_partition_by_cells_municipality_cells_period_start",
        0
      ),
      0
    ) AS "cells.current",
    _cm_cells__population__n_sum_partition_by_municipality_period_start."population.n_sum_partition_by_cells_municipality_cells_period_start" AS "population.n_sum_partition_by_cells_municipality_cells_period_start",
    _cm_cells__vehicles__n_sum."vehicles.n_sum" AS "vehicles.n_sum"
  FROM _base
  LEFT JOIN _cm_cells__population__n_sum_partition_by_municipality_period_start
    ON _base."cells.municipality" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_cells__population__n_sum_partition_by_municipality_period_start."population.cells.municipality"
    AND _base."cells.period_start" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_cells__population__n_sum_partition_by_municipality_period_start."population.cells.period_start"
  LEFT JOIN _cm_cells__vehicles__n_sum
    ON _base."cells.municipality" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_cells__vehicles__n_sum."vehicles.cells.municipality"
    AND _base."cells.vehicles.kind" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_cells__vehicles__n_sum."vehicles.kind"
    AND _base."cells.period_start" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_cells__vehicles__n_sum."vehicles.cells.period_start"
), shifted_previous AS (
  SELECT
    "cells.period_start" AS "cells.period_start",
    "cells.municipality" AS "cells.municipality",
    "cells.vehicles.kind" AS "cells.vehicles.kind",
    "cells.current" AS "cells.current"
  FROM base
), sjoin_previous AS (
  SELECT
    base."cells.municipality",
    base."cells.vehicles.kind",
    base."cells.period_start",
    base."cells.current",
    base."population.n_sum_partition_by_cells_municipality_cells_period_start",
    base."vehicles.n_sum",
    shifted_previous."cells.current" AS "cells.previous"
  FROM base
  LEFT JOIN shifted_previous
    ON base."cells.period_start" - INTERVAL 1 YEAR IS NOT DISTINCT FROM shifted_previous."cells.period_start"
    AND base."cells.municipality" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM shifted_previous."cells.municipality"
    AND base."cells.vehicles.kind" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM shifted_previous."cells.vehicles.kind"
), step1 AS (
  SELECT
    "cells.municipality",
    "cells.vehicles.kind",
    "cells.period_start",
    "cells.current",
    "population.n_sum_partition_by_cells_municipality_cells_period_start",
    "vehicles.n_sum",
    "cells.previous",
    "cells.current" - "cells.previous" AS "cells.change"
  FROM sjoin_previous
)
SELECT
  "cells.municipality",
  "cells.vehicles.kind",
  "cells.period_start",
  "cells.current",
  "cells.previous",
  "cells.change"
FROM (
  SELECT
    "cells.municipality",
    "cells.vehicles.kind",
    "cells.period_start",
    "cells.current",
    "population.n_sum_partition_by_cells_municipality_cells_period_start",
    "vehicles.n_sum",
    "cells.previous",
    "cells.change"
  FROM step1
) AS _outer
